method: Independent audit of ROADMAP-REVIEW.md against PRD, OPERATING-RULES, phase evidence, telemetry/runs.jsonl, and tools/orchestrate-review.py. No production code modified for the audit conclusions.
verdict_rationale: Directionally right that evidence-tier extension should wait on measurement and that H-CI should precede Harness/3.3. Material factual errors (Phase 0.5 treated as unbuilt; orchestration treated as never-run) and a process over-correction (§12 vs PRD §13 null-result rule) change the roadmap conclusion enough that the document should not be adopted as written.

findings.claim: Act 1 (manual baseline harness) was scoped as Phase 0.5 but was never built.
evidence: tools/PHASE-0.5-CLOSE.md: marks Phase 0.5 DONE with checked exit criteria (headless real runs, blind validators, reality-asserting gates, RUN-LEDGER cost/latency/intervention logging, fake-pass regression fixture)
PRD.md:453-461: Phase 0.5 is the §13 baseline arm and Act 1 of the demo
tools/RUN-LEDGER.md referenced by PHASE-0.5-CLOSE as carrying the five validator runs and operator-intervention=1 proof
findings.recommended_change: Rewrite the demo gap: Phase 0.5 exists and closed; what is missing is packaging it as the Act 1 narrative beat and connecting it to a command-orchestrated Act 2. Do not plan to rebuild Act 1 from zero.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Roadmap spends a full priority rebuilding work already done, delays the only demo beat that does not depend on Mission-native automation, and misstates project maturity to any external reader.

findings.claim: orchestrate-review.py was built but never successfully run; phase-3.2/reviews/orchestrated/ contains empty 0-byte files.
evidence: telemetry/runs.jsonl: 10 rows, all phase-3.2; 8 rows point at phase-3.2/reviews/orchestrated/* envelopes
telemetry/runs.jsonl rows include non-zero token runs and real decisions: ACCEPT, ACCEPT-WITH-NITS, REJECT, ERROR, UNKNOWN
phase-3.2/reviews/orchestrated/review-grok-4.5-envelope.json is currently 10603 bytes with a full review body; some sibling files are 0-byte (partial/flaky, not never-ran)
tools/orchestrate-review.py step5_append_telemetry writes runs.jsonl — the 8 orchestrated rows are evidence the script's telemetry path executed
findings.recommended_change: Correct to: orchestration ran multiple times with partial success and residual flakiness (empty envelopes, gemini ERROR/UNKNOWN rows). Priority 1 is stabilize + make deterministic, not invent the loop from nothing.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Overstates foundation breakage, mis-sizes Priority 1, and hides the already-available signal that the panel disagrees under orchestration (grok REJECT vs gemini ACCEPT).

findings.claim: telemetry/runs.jsonl contains only 6 rows, all from Phase 3.2; §13 efficacy evaluation has no data.
evidence: telemetry/runs.jsonl: wc -l => 10 rows (not 6)
phase-3/gen-telemetry.py: auditable recipe to regenerate Phase 3 rows from committed envelopes
phase-3.2/SPIKE.md control-arm citation: ≈540.6k tokens over 12 successful Phase 3 role runs from envelopes
phase-1/RUN-LEDGER.md and tools/RUN-LEDGER.md: structured cost rows outside runs.jsonl
findings.recommended_change: Say the system-of-record file is incomplete and Phase-mixed data was lost/overwritten locally, but §13 inputs are partially recoverable from envelopes + ledgers. Distinguish missing SoR from missing evidence.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Undervalues recoverable evaluation inputs and overstates the 'no measurement possible' case.

findings.claim: Default HMAC signing key ("local-default-key") is in-repo and forgeable; gate would PASS on a forged green bundle.
evidence: phase-3.2/ASSUMPTIONS.md §1: documents the initial hardcoded key, the grok finding, and the fix (random key if unset; consumer requires explicit key)
phase-3.2/evidence/local_backend.py: uses os.urandom(32) when EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY unset; warns signature is same-process only
phase-3.2/evidence/consumer.py: --signing-key-env EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY; no hardcoded shared secret in current consumer path
rg local-default-key across *.py: no remaining secret default (only ASSUMPTIONS/review prose + key_id label 'local-default')
findings.recommended_change: Reclassify as a closed finding with residual gap: key distribution for multi-agent/CI is still unspecified. Do not list forgeable default key as a current open trust hole.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Roadmap prioritizes an already-fixed nit and underweights the real residual (key distribution / producer authenticity in CI).

findings.claim: If a phase's safety mechanism was not triggered, the phase is not complete — deliberately construct a triggering case or record a named gap.
evidence: PRD.md:572: 'models disagree at least once' are NOT success gates; both would incentivize manufactured findings. A clean null result is valid data.
ROADMAP-REVIEW.md §5 §12: phases that did not trigger reconciliation/retry are 'not complete' / 'incomplete with a clean null result'
phase-2/APPROVAL.md + phase-2/findings.md: exit criterion was hash-bound approval OR escalated non-convergence; round-1 APPROVE with amendments satisfied the written exit
findings.recommended_change: Rewrite §12 to match PRD §13: clean null is valid completion data. Require explicit recording of unexercised safety paths as known gaps / follow-ons, without reopening phase completion or mandating manufactured disagreement. Optional adversarial fixtures are calibration work, not exit gates.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Creates Goodhart pressure to stage fake conflicts, contradicts the evaluation design, and turns honest null results into process failures.

findings.claim: Fix orchestration first, then H-CI, then adversarial path, then build the demo; foundations-before-extending is the right frame.
evidence: F-RR-001/002: 0.5 exists; orchestration already partially runs
phase-0/GO-NO-GO.md: build is command-orchestrated, not Mission-native; Probe 5 Mission rejection routing unreachable
PRD.md:625-633 Act 2 demo narrative is Mission-shaped ('same sprint as a Mission', Droid Computer), which the GO decision already rejected as the runtime spine
telemetry/runs.jsonl: orchestrated panel already produced grok REJECT vs gemini ACCEPT — disagreement data exists without a dedicated 'adversarial construction' phase
phase-3.2/SPIKE.md §3: H-CI is the headline economic experiment; predicted partial win; null result redirects roadmap
findings.recommended_change: Adopt a revised sequence: (1) minimal orchestration harden (adapter shim, non-empty envelope assert, deterministic multi-run) — days not a program; (2) H-CI N-run immediately, because it decides whether evidence-tier investment continues; (3) demo packaging now that 0.5 exists — Act 1 = closed 0.5 harness, Act 2 = command-orchestrated button not Mission fantasy, Act 3 only on Phase-0-verified controls; (4) adversarial-path calibration fixtures as measurement, not blockers; (5) Harness/3.3/dogfood only after H-CI.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Priority 1 expands into endless plumbing; demo stays blocked on a Mission story the architecture abandoned; H-CI (the economic fork) slips behind work that does not change the fork.

findings.claim: Demo treatment is adequate: build Act 1+2+3 after orchestration/cost/adversarial evidence.
evidence: PRD.md:607-644 three-act narrative; Act 2 is Mission automation; Act 3 constrained to Phase-0-verified capabilities
phase-0/GO-NO-GO.md recommendation: GO with mandatory design change to command-orchestrated
ROADMAP-REVIEW never reconciles Act 2's Mission script with the command-orchestrated spine
tools/PHASE-0.5-CLOSE.md already supplies Act 1 substance (manual/ladder harness with cost and intervention counts)
findings.recommended_change: Add an explicit demo-strategy decision: rewrite Act 2 around the command-orchestrated wrapper (push a scripted button, close laptop only if a real durable runner exists — do not demo Mission). Keep Act 3 strictly inside verified probes. Package 0.5 as Act 1 immediately.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Demo either overclaims Mission capabilities Phase 0 disproved, or never ships because it waits on a path the GO decision closed.

findings.claim: The orchestration script should have been built in Phase 1, not discovered in Phase 3.2.
evidence: PRD.md:463-467 Phase 1 exit is invalid-RED rejection + hashed RED→GREEN on one behavior — not full multi-role orchestration

phase-0/GO-NO-GO.md 'Build order for Phase 1': reference guard, per-role invocation wrapper, locked-test enforcement, isolation, rejection state machine — a thinner wrapper than today's multi-validator orchestrate-review.py
phase-3/README.md: Phase 3 is where full loop + cross-family validation became the operating mode
findings.recommended_change: Keep the missed-win, retarget the timing: per-role invocation wrapper belonged at Phase 0 contingency / Phase 1 spine; full review orchestration belonged no later than Phase 3 kickoff. 'Should have been Phase 1' overstates relative to Phase 1's written exit.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Blames the wrong phase gate and teaches the wrong sizing lesson for future vertical slices.

findings.claim: Reconciliation/retry never tested under disagreement is among the highest-leverage next proofs; deliberately construct blocking cases.
evidence: PRD.md:572 clean null is valid; disagreement is not a success gate
phase-2/findings.md: Grok raised medium/low findings that became binding amendments A1–A5 without re-review by design (hash freeze + zero-buffer)
telemetry/runs.jsonl: already contains orchestrated REJECT vs ACCEPT split on 3.2 code review
phase-3.1/RESULTS.md (cited in review): degraded-loop panel split already produced disagreement data
findings.recommended_change: Downgrade from 'must exercise before close' to 'calibration backlog with named fixtures.' Mine existing disagreement (Phase 2 amendments path, 3.1 split, 3.2 orchestrated REJECT) before manufacturing new ones. If a fixture is built, label it calibration, not phase-completion.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Burns budget on staged fights while real disagreement corpora sit unanalyzed; conflicts with evaluation ethics in PRD §13.

findings.claim: Across Phase 2 and Phase 3, Gemini raised zero findings in every review except Phase 3.1 degraded chunk 1; panel independence is concentrated in one family.
evidence: phase-2/findings.md: Gemini 0 findings / APPROVE; Grok 3 medium + 3 low — claim holds for Phase 2
phase-3/build-evidence/chunk{1,2,3}-validator-gemini-envelope.json: ACCEPT with multi-step evidence walkthroughs, not empty confirms — still zero blocking findings
telemetry/runs.jsonl orchestrated rows: gemini ACCEPT paired with grok REJECT on later 3.2 reviews — strengthens the calibration concern beyond the review's sample
findings.recommended_change: Keep the calibration finding; sharpen it: Gemini is not a no-op reviewer (it produces long evidenced ACCEPTs) but it is systematically non-blocking relative to Grok. Add 3.2 orchestrated REJECT/ACCEPT split as additional evidence. Treat as Phase 5 calibration input, not a roadmap fork by itself.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Either over-dismisses Gemini (throws away a seat) or under-measures precision/recall per family for §13.

findings.claim: The listed missed wins (orchestration timing, telemetry, reconciliation, invalid-RED, review-tests, exit criteria, executor over-spec, signing key, Gemini, adapter bypass) are the material set.
evidence: Missing: Phase 0.5 closed but never productized as Act 1 (F-RR-001)
Missing: Act 2 narrative still Mission-native after GO-NO-GO forbade that spine (F-RR-007)

Missing: KI-2 validator Execute write vector remains detective-only across Phase 2 and 3 (phase-2/KNOWN-ISSUES.md KI-2, phase-3/KNOWN-ISSUES.md KI-2) — independence hole for any demo of 'read-only validators'
Missing: Probe 5/7 still unanswered (review notes this in §1 table) but does not promote the durable-runner / laptop-closed claim as a demo blocker
Accurate and material among listed: §3.4 invalid-RED, §3.5 review-tests, §3.6 Phase 3 exits, §3.7 executor given the answer, §3.10 adapter bypass
findings.recommended_change: Add missed wins: (a) 0.5 not packaged as Act 1; (b) demo Act 2 not rewritten for command-orchestration; (c) validator write-vector still unenforced; (d) 'close the laptop' durability never evidenced. Keep §3.4–3.7 and §3.10. Drop or close §3.8 as fixed.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Roadmap optimizes the wrong backlog and ships a demo that fails the first engineer question about Mission vs wrapper or validator purity.

findings.claim: Proposed operating rules §9–§14 are sound additions.
evidence: §9 script-the-loop: matches Phase 0 command-orchestrated contingency and observed manual drift — sound if scoped to multi-invocation phases, not every spike probe
§10 telemetry-by-script: sound; already partially implemented in orchestrate-review.py step 5
§11 check exit criteria against artifacts: sound and overdue (Phase 1/3 exits)
§12 adversarial-must-fire: unsound as written (F-RR-005)
§13 don't give executor the answer: sound; phase-1/prompts/executor.md lines 18-33 are the smoking gun vs PRD §5.5
§14 use adapter shim: sound; orchestrate-review.py docstring cites adapters/factory.py but body parses envelope['usage']['input_tokens'] raw at lines 160-161
findings.recommended_change: Accept §9 (with spike exception), §10, §11, §13, §14. Reject/rewrite §12 per F-RR-005. Add one missing rule: demo claims must bind to Phase-0-verified capabilities and the command-orchestrated decision (no Mission demo beats without a new GO).
findings.risk_if_ignored: Either codifies a harmful completeness rule (§12) or leaves the demo-claim/verification binding unenforced.

findings.claim: Current roadmap order is Harness backend → H-CI → 3.3 → dogfood → Phase 5 → Phase 6; this should be inverted so evidence-tier extension is last.
evidence: phase-3.2/BUILD-NOTES.md follow-ons list Harness before H-CI — review's 'current sequencing' read is fair
phase-3.2/SPIKE.md §3: H-CI is the headline experiment that should decide further backend investment
Agree with review: Harness-before-H-CI is the wrong order
findings.recommended_change: Keep the deferral of Harness/3.3/dogfood until after H-CI. Do not treat this portion as contested.
findings.risk_if_ignored: Building Harness/3.3 before H-CI risks scaffolding an abstraction whose token thesis may null out.

findings.claim: Implied constraint model is 'fix foundations then extend'; no explicit budget/timeline/platform constraint shaping.
evidence: phase-0/GO-NO-GO.md: platform silent-green is structural; durable Mission path unavailable
phase-3/KNOWN-ISSUES.md KI-1: planned cheap openai executor tier was unavailable; glm substitution
PRD.md:87 H3 conditional on Probe 7; command-orchestrated path partially unblocked per-role credits
Review proposes six new operating rules + five priority programs without a capacity envelope
findings.recommended_change: Add a constraints stanza: near-term capacity is one orchestration harden + one H-CI experiment + demo packaging. Defer rule-lawyering expansion, manufactured adversarial campaigns, and new evidence backends until H-CI returns. Name platform limits (no Mission Act 2, no unverified laptop-closed claim).
findings.risk_if_ignored: The re-sequence becomes another unbounded backlog and recreates the missed-exit pattern it criticizes.

missed_wins_scorecard.note: Missed automation is real; 'never ran' and 'should have been Phase 1' are overstated.
SoR gap real; row count wrong; 'no §13 data' overstates recoverability.
True gap; must not become a manufactured-disagreement exit gate.
valid-red.py exists; invalid cases not demonstrated; RED taken from designer envelope.
PRD §11 Phase 1 first deliverable still external.
Demo/baseline/PR exits unmet remains correct for Phase 3.
Executor prompt contains the exact one-line fix; H3 seat untested.
Finding was real; code/ASSUMPTIONS show fix landed. Residual is key distribution.
Calibration concentration real; Gemini is lenient/non-blocking more than silent.
Docstring cites adapter; implementation raw-parses Factory fields.

proposed_resequence.priority_1: Harden orchestration just enough for N identical runs (adapter shim, fail on empty envelope, stray-write check, telemetry append). Do not boil the ocean.
proposed_resequence.priority_2: Run H-CI N-run A/B with provider tokenizers. This is the economic fork for all evidence-tier work.
proposed_resequence.priority_3: Demo packaging: Act 1 = existing Phase 0.5 close artifacts; Act 2 = command-orchestrated script (honest rewrite of PRD Mission beat); Act 3 = only Phase-0-verified controls. No Mission cosplay.
proposed_resequence.priority_4: Calibration backlog (not gates): invalid-RED fixtures, mine existing disagreement corpora (2/3.1/3.2), optional retry/re-plan fixture, Gemini precision study.
proposed_resequence.priority_5: Evidence-tier extension (Harness backend, 3.3 visual, framework dogfood) only if H-CI is non-null or explicitly accepted as coverage-not-cost.
proposed_resequence.deferred_unchanged: Phase 5 hardening settling pass; Phase 6 human compression post-MVP pain.

add: Demo claims bind to Phase-0-verified capabilities and the command-orchestrated GO decision
Capacity envelope: name the next 1–3 deliverables; refuse unbounded foundation programs
